decisions.description: Checks whether the record was just updated to be Blacklisted, or Do Not Call and Email Opt Out, and did not meet those criteria before this update. Only then is the Status set to Do Not Engage, so a Title change or an edit to a record that already met the criteria does not reset the Status.

decisions.description: Checks whether the Title changed on this update, so the Seniority Level is only recalculated when the Title changes.

Flow.description: Sets the Status to Do Not Engage if the record is Blacklisted or DNC and Email Opt Out. Sets the Seniority Level based on the Title when the Title changes.
